column1: # Fixed native-preservation corpus; four columns are id, x, y, z.
# The first 25 rows are a 5x5 grid of central chunks at requested y=-240.
# chunksize=5 gives central y origin -272 and full emerged y [-288,-177].
# Grid central x/z origins are -192,-112,-32,48,128; requested positions
# are each origin + 40, so every id names one unique mapchunk.
# The grid is a bounded Gennotify search scope, not a pre-accepted dungeon or
# random-walk-cave witness. The gate requires real cave_begin/cave_end (or
# large-cave) and dungeon notifications from this grid; no absence inference.
# The following fixed slices cover the five registered production strata, and
# the final two rows are aggregate native-ore census slices. Their presence is
# checked by node census, not invented from source names.
